Pairwise orderings with worst-case verdicts, critical additive deviations δ*, critical odds-ratio factors Γ*, illustrative symmetric and asymmetric (−15/+5 pp) stress-test verdicts, and bootstrap determination shares.

Sensitivity analyses across 17 cohort, support, weighting, aggregation, and multistate variants, with common-support cells, determined pairwise orderings under worst-case bounds and at δ = 5 pp, and changes relative to the main analysis.

Common-support retention by pathogen group, with eligible and retained outbreaks and cases, the settings and periods losing most cases, and crude (unstandardized) proportions before and after the restriction.
Record audit of outbreak outcome fields (C reported cases, H hospitalized, K cases with known hospitalization status), with category counts and handling. No record had a count contradiction.
Outbreak-level bootstrap (2,000 replicates, seed 20261125; 0/2,000 resamples lacked K_rec), with verdict shares and percentile ranges of δ*.

Joint 30-hypothesis two-sided FWER inference combining Imbens–Manski 95% CIs, outbreak-HC1 and 53-state Gaussian Max-T stepdown, studentized non-Gaussian bootstrap Max-T, and dynamic 95% confidence tipping points.
